📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The changes add owned-relation type validation and hydration, preserve DECIMAL values during hydration, and add resource-model write and query methods. They also update connection and transaction value checks, Composer metadata, and changelog documentation. ### Changes **Owned Relation State** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**RelationState validation and hydration**
`src/Domain/Model/RelationState.php`, `src/Metadata/ResourceModelMetadataValidator.php`, `src/Application/Service/Hydration/ResourceModelHydrator.php`, `tests/Fixture/Metadata/*`, `tests/Unit/Metadata/OwnedRelationTypingTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Persistence/OptimisticLockingTest.php`, `CHANGELOG.md`|Owned relation validation rejects declared properties whose types do not admit `RelationState`. Hydration uses `RelationState` for admitted relation types. Fixtures and tests cover union types and plain-array rejection.| **Decimal Casting** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Decimal casting and precision checks**
`src/Application/Service/Hydration/TypeCaster.php`, `tests/Unit/Hydration/DecimalPrecisionTest.php`|MySQL and SQLite DECIMAL values use string-preserving conversion paths. Tests cover preserved precision, float properties, and non-exponent formatting.| **Resource-Model Writes** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Shared resource-model write path**
`src/Application/Service/Persistence/AggregateWriteEngine.php`, `tests/Unit/Persistence/ResourceChangedEventDispatchTest.php`, `CHANGELOG.md`|Insert, update, and delete delegate to `write`, which performs the operation and dispatches a change event. The method returns the resource model. A test covers direct insert and delete calls.| **Resource-Model Queries** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Query creation, filters, and daily counts**
`src/OrmManager.php`, `src/Query/CollectionQueryCompiler.php`, `src/Query/ResourceModelQuery.php`, `tests/Unit/Query/QueryAggregationTest.php`, `CHANGELOG.md`|OrmManager adds a query factory. Query filters support inclusive bounds, and `contains` rejects array values. `countByDay` returns date-grouped counts. Tests cover grouping, null timestamps, and filtering.| **Runtime Value Checks** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Pool and transaction value checks**
`src/Adapter/ConnectionPool.php`, `src/Adapter/SingleConnectionPool.php`, `src/Application/Service/Transaction/TransactionManager.php`, `src/OrmManager.php`|Connection and coroutine values receive runtime type checks. `OrmManager::getPool()` checks the pool after coroutine-safety handling.| **Package and API Metadata** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Composer and changelog updates**
`composer.json`, `CHANGELOG.md`|Composer extra configuration sets `semitexa/core` to `next`. The changelog adds section-format guidance and Unreleased entries.| |**Repository constructor documentation**
